description.value: You gain nourishment in the same way that plants do, through a combination of photosynthesis, and absorbing minerals through your roots. You typically do not need to pay for food. If you go without sunlight for 1 week, you begin to starve. You can derive nourishment from specially formulated bottles of sunlight instead of natural sunlight, but these bottles cost 10 times as much as standard rations.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
